name: Umbrella Network
fix_description: In _withdraw, add require(_balances[user] >= amount) before subtracting. Contract uses Solidity 0.7.5 without SafeMath for these operations, allowing integer underflow when withdrawing more than staked balance.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-step exploit against an obvious arithmetic underflow in withdraw, requiring only one external call and no meaningful protocol-specific DeFi knowledge. A competent auditor could identify and reproduce this quickly from the vulnerable balance accounting logic.
